title: Wizardos
description: Real-time multiplayer wizard battles in blocky voxel arenas. Cast Fire, Ice, Wind, Light, Toxic and Earth spells that combine with each other, such as a fireball turning a tornado into a fire tornado. Modes include Team Deathmatch, Free-for-All, 1v1 duels and boss fights, plus a block-by-block map editor.
how_to_play: Join a match from the menu and cast spells at the other wizards. Works on computers, phones and tablets. The game shows its controls on screen.
